steps: Open a fresh normal URL, click Play, search Patancheru visibly and choose Start here. First offer: Swiss Cafe Hyd, 893 m to pickup, then 1,302 m to Home in Patancheru, with 231 s after collection and 126 base coins. Save the offer original and click the actual Accept button.
Open M and click actual Close map. Root observed focus returning to the minimap. ArrowUp 1.5 s, ArrowUp+ArrowRight 0.45 s and ArrowDown 0.5 s: approximately 875 m, 0–1 km/h, at a median.
ArrowUp 0.8 s: 874 m and 4 km/h during repeated grounded contact on the same median side; no crossing observed. The later saved median-contact original shows 874 m and 0 km/h.
ArrowDown 0.65 s, ArrowUp+ArrowLeft 0.6 s, ArrowUp 3.5 s and ArrowDown 0.65 s. Open M and click actual Close map again: 871 m, 11 km/h, with the car roughly perpendicular to the median.
Click the visible game scene at pixel (290,360). ArrowDown 1 s, ArrowUp+ArrowLeft 1.1 s, ArrowUp 3.5 s and ArrowDown 0.75 s: 870 m and 13 km/h, still on the same median side.
Press R for normal recovery and observe the settled result: 868 m and 0 km/h, parallel to a clear road. No transient recovery-animation frame was treated as a settled result.
ArrowUp 5.5 s and ArrowDown 1.1 s. Final unpaused HUD: 969 m to Swiss Cafe Hyd, 0 km/h, 5.0 s boost, 802 coins, Level 2 1/4, Day 8 5:49 AM. Save the ending original.

Press Escape to open Paused, mark tab 1933378327 as a handoff and release all input. Warning/error console query returned no entries (limit 50). No flight, E hold, collection, handover or reward occurred. Root released the browser at approximately 21:50 UTC; all evidence-helper tabs were closed.
